verses.text: A message about Nineveh: the vision Nahum the Elkoshite saw.
The LORD is jealous and takes revenge. The LORD takes revenge and is furious. He takes vengeance on his enemies and holds anger against his foes.
The LORD is slow to anger and great in power, but he will never leave the guilty unpunished. He moves through whirlwinds and storms, and clouds are the dust beneath his feet.
He rebukes the sea and makes it dry; he dries up every river. Bashan and Carmel wither, and Lebanon’s flowers fade.
The mountains shake before him and the hills melt. The earth trembles in his presence—the whole world and everyone living in it.
Who can stand against his fury? Who can endure his burning anger? His wrath pours out like fire, and rocks break apart before him.
The LORD is good, a safe place in trouble. He knows those who take refuge in him.
But he will sweep away Nineveh’s place with an overwhelming flood and chase his enemies into darkness.
What are you plotting against the LORD? He will bring it to a complete end. Trouble won’t rise a second time.
They are tangled like thorns and drunk on their wine; they will be consumed like dry straw.
Someone has come from you who plans evil against the LORD and gives wicked advice.
The LORD says: “Though they are strong and many, they will be cut down and disappear. Judah, though I brought hardship on you, I won’t do it again.
“Now I will break the yoke they put on you and snap your chains.”

The LORD has commanded about you: “You will have no descendants to carry on your name. I will remove the carved and cast idols from the house of your gods. I will prepare your grave, because you are vile.”

Look! On the mountains are the feet of someone bringing good news and announcing peace. Judah, celebrate your festivals and keep your promises! The wicked will never invade you again; they have been completely destroyed.
